[completeness review 2026-10-03] Manual §5.5 prints P(N_D) = C(N,N_D)(π11+π22)^N_D (π12+π21)^(N-N_D); for N_D ~ B(N, π_D) the exponents are swapped (should be (π12+π21)^N_D (π11+π22)^(N-N_D)). Implementers must not copy the printed formula.

[second review pass 2026-10-03] Manual §5.1 prints OR = (d + πD)/(d − πD) for d = π12 − π21. From π12 = (πD + d)/2 and π21 = (πD − d)/2 the ratio is OR = (πD + d)/(πD − d); the printed form is negative whenever |d| < πD (with the §5.3 values πD = 0.4, d = −0.24 it gives −0.25 instead of 0.25). Confirmed on the rendered page 14. Use the corrected form in drawer/conversion code.
